text: Ethics in AI is becoming an important topic today. As artificial intelligence systems make more decisions in our lives, we must think about how they affect people. One major concern is bias, because AI can learn unfair patterns from the data it receives. This can lead to unfair treatment of certain groups, so fairness must always be considered. Privacy is another key issue, since AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies and governments should be transparent about how these systems work and what data they use. Finally, responsible AI development means building technology that respects human values and serves everyone fairly.
